rows.what: Emirates NBD Bank (P.J.S.C.) subscribed to 92,91,34,820 new shares at INR 280 (INR 26,015.77 crore) on 18 June 2026, taking 60% of RBL Bank's expanded capital, and completed a mandatory 26% open offer in which nil shares were tendered. Emirates NBD is now promoter; the Bank is its subsidiary.

Avenir Investment RSC Ltd, owned and controlled by International Holding Company PJSC (IHC), Abu Dhabi, subscribed to a Rs 8,850 crore preferential issue of shares and warrants at Rs 139, completed a 26.05% open offer on May 14, 2026, acquired control and became promoter of the previously promoter-less company from May 15, 2026.

Inspira Global (Agrawal family), through Lenexis Foodworks and affiliates, acquired control of Restaurant Brands Asia: ₹900 crore preferential equity plus ₹600 crore warrants, purchase of QSR Asia's entire 11.26% stake at ₹70, and a 26% open offer. Completed 7 July 2026; Everstone-backed QSR Asia exited and was reclassified public.

Promoter Epsilon Bidco Pte. Ltd. (Blackstone vehicle, ultimate beneficial owner Sun Yiming) sold its entire 26.37% holding in EPL on 1 September 2026 through on-market/block trades, falling to 0%. Buyers were institutional investors (Bandhan MF, PSP Investment Board, ADIA and others); no new promoter emerged. Board approved its reclassification from promoter to public.

The promoter group (API Holdings / Docon Technologies) sold down roughly 20% of Thyrocare in two large blocks, reportedly to repay group debt, falling from 71.06% to 51.02%. Docon was then amalgamated into fellow promoter-group company API Holdings, with no change in aggregate promoter holding. API retains majority control.

Promoter Sagility B.V. sold down in the open market. Promoter-group holding fell from 67.38% (Sep 2025) to 50.95% (Dec 2025), and a further 11.96% sale on 2026-11-19 left it at 38.99%. No new promoter or controlling owner arrived; Sagility B.V. remains promoter.

Promoter entities Tenneco Mauritius Holdings Ltd and Tenneco (Mauritius) Ltd sold about 15% of capital in open-market/block sales disclosed 2026-08-18. Promoter-group holding fell from 74.79% to 59.79%, retaining majority control; SBI Mutual Fund schemes picked up 5.21%, reaching 6.1%. No new controller arrived.

Promoter entity Samayat Services LLP sold 13.97% of VMM's capital on 2026-03-02, cutting promoter-group holding from 54.09% to 40.12%. Institutions such as HDFC Mutual Fund (+2.9%) picked up stock. The same promoter group stayed in control; no new controlling owner appeared and no open offer was made.

The scheme of amalgamation of Quality Care India Limited into Aster DM Healthcare became effective 1 July 2026. Shares issued under the scheme made BCP Asia II Topco IV Pte. Ltd. a promoter holding 29.71% — larger than founder Azad Moopen's 24.01%. Promoter-group holding rose from 40.39% to 53.72%; the company was renamed Aster DM Quality Care India Limited.

Promoter holding company Jupiter Capital Private Limited sold large blocks of AXISCADES shares — 2.35% disclosed 2026-07-08 (leaving 50.15%) and 10.86% disclosed 2026-10-06 (leaving 39.29%). Promoter-and-group holding fell from 58.08% to 44.82%. No buyer, open offer or control transfer is disclosed; Jupiter remains the largest holder and promoter.

Promoter-and-group holding fell from 83.29% to 71.48% between the March 2026 and the off-cycle 4 June 2026 shareholding pattern, with no filing text showing any sale, agreement or open offer; promoters still hold 71.4% and retain control. The move is consistent with fresh share issuance diluting the promoter percentage.

Sumedh Tools Private Limited, a promoter group entity, sold 5,83,43,040 shares (6.56% of capital) through a block deal on 23 December 2025, cutting its stake to nil. The company said this was promoter group stake rationalisation with no change in control or management; existing promoters continue.

Promoter holding rose from 55% to 66.29% purely through fresh share issues to the promoters: shares allotted under the NCLT-approved composite scheme (Asia Investments' Automotive Undertaking demerged into Gabriel) in June 2026, then a preferential allotment of 1,44,04,204 shares to Asia Investments Private Limited as consideration for HL Mando ANAND India shares. Same ANAND Group control.

Promoter Whirlpool Mauritius Limited sold 11.24% of the capital in the open market on 2025-12-08, cutting promoter-and-group holding from 51.0% to 39.76%. No new promoter or controlling owner arrived; the same promoter group remains in control at 39.76% through subsequent quarters.

Blackstone-affiliated promoter BCP Topco VII Pte. Ltd. sold its entire 75.19% stake — 28,20,52,121 shares to BCP Asia II Holdco VII Pte. Ltd. at ₹425 and 4,41,39,236 shares to AXDI LDII SPV 1 LTD. With a completed open offer, the Acquirer took control and became promoter on 26 February 2026; the old promoter group was reclassified as public.

The Company completed a Qualified Institutions Placement raising Rs.1,613.97 crore by allotting equity shares to qualified institutional buyers. Promoter holding fell from 84.02% to 74.03% purely from the new issue; public holding rose to 25.97%, meeting minimum public shareholding norms. No promoter sold and no new controller arrived.

Promoter-and-group holding fell from 54.45% to 44.68% only because the company issued fresh shares — a preferential allotment in January 2026 (6.88% to Mylan Inc) and a further 87,86,362 shares allotted on 2026-06-29. Reg 29 shows promoters neither sold nor bought any shares.

JSW Infrastructure raised capital through a qualified institutions placement combined with an offer for sale by Sajjan Jindal Family Trust, the promoter selling shareholder, to meet minimum public shareholding. Promoter-group holding fell from 83.62% to 73.93%; the Jindal promoter group still controls the company.

The promoter block held by BCP Topco IX Pte. Ltd. (Blackstone) was sold down by about 9.5% of capital around 18 December 2025, taking promoter-and-group holding from 40.1% to 30.59%. Institutions such as Kotak Mahindra Mutual Fund bought in the market. The same promoter still holds about 30.5% and controls the company.

Promoter entity Vivira Investment & Trading Private Limited sold a 9.29% block in the open market in early January 2026, cutting its holding to 29.74% and total promoter-group holding from 69.89% to 60.6%. SBI Mutual Fund picked up 5.73%. Promoters retain majority control; management unchanged.

Promoter entities (Aeon Trading LLP, Lloyds Metals & Minerals Trading LLP, Lloyds Enterprises Limited) sold about 7.15% of capital in the open market, largely picked up by Thriveni Earthmovers (non-promoter), which now holds 9.05%. Promoter-group holding fell 49.26% to 40.0%; Lloyds Enterprises still holds 32.66% and retains control.

General Atlantic Singapore Fund Pte Ltd, the private-equity promoter, sold 8.76% of KFin Technologies in one transaction on 2026-08-25, cutting promoter-group holding from 22.82% to 14.06%. Mirae Asset Mutual Fund and other public investors bought; no new promoter or controller emerged. Two non-shareholding promoter-group entities were also reclassified to public.

General Atlantic Singapore RR Pte. Ltd., a promoter-classified financial sponsor, sold about 8.45% of Rubicon Research's capital on 2026-09-01, cutting its holding to 27.34%. Total promoter-group holding fell from 59.76% to 51.25%; no new promoter or controlling owner arrived, and management continued unchanged.

JSW Paints Limited completed its acquisition of 60.76% of Akzo Nobel India under a share purchase agreement on 10 December 2025, after an open offer, taking 61.2%. The Akzo Nobel sellers were reclassified from promoter to public, and the company was renamed JSW Dulux Limited.

Existing promoter entities raised their stake from 46.21% to 54.53% by buying 8.32% in open-market/block purchases — Electrosteel Thermal Coal Ltd bought 3.32% (March 2026) and Wilcox Merchants Pvt Ltd with PACs bought 5% (October 2026). Non-promoter funds sold down. No new controller.

The President of India, through the Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance, sold about 8.08% of the bank's capital, cutting promoter holding from 89.27% to 81.19%. Life Insurance Corporation of India picked up 2.9%, reaching 6.05%. The Government remains the controlling promoter.

Promoter Manish Mohanka gifted 72,78,925 equity shares (9.69% of capital) off-market to MM Business Trust, a promoter-group trust with Mehul Mohanka as trustee, under a SEBI inter-se transfer exemption. Aggregate promoter-group holding stayed 67.50% with no change in control or management. Earlier, a preferential allotment diluted promoters from 74.8% to 67.27%.

No change of control. The promoter group stayed at 68.31% through June 2026, then eased to 60.78% in an off-cycle 20 July 2026 shareholding pattern filed after a capital restructuring, i.e. fresh shares issued. The same promoters still hold a controlling 60.78%. The only filing is Torrent's own purchase of JB Chemicals shares.

The Piramal-family promoter entities sold down ~26% of VIP Industries through open-market/block transactions in late December 2025, and Multiples Private Equity Fund IV and its Gift Fund IV picked up ~18.7%, holding ~22.9%. The company's own presentation calls it a completed 'Change of Control', with a new CEO and senior team.

Adani group exited as promoter: Adani Commodities LLP sold its remaining stake (7% then 13%) and the Adani entities applied on 27 November 2025 to be reclassified from promoter to public. Lence Pte. Ltd. bought 13% and holds 56.94%, leaving it as sole promoter.

Promoter F.I.L.A. Fabbrica Italiana Lapis Ed Affini S.p.A. sold 7% of DOMS' capital on 2026-06-22, cutting its holding to 19.01%. Total promoter-group holding fell from 70.39% to 63.39%. No new promoter or controlling owner arrived; the remaining promoter group continues to control the company.

In February 2026 the Lodha promoter family sold about 3.65% of the capital in the open market, taking promoter-group holding from 71.0% to 66.98%. The same family continues to control the company; management said no further dilution is planned. Later holding fell to 64.16%.

Exchange shareholding register shows promoter-and-group holding flat at 79.81% through 2026-06-30, then 73.15% at an interim 2026-07-09 pattern and unchanged at 2026-09-30 — a 6.66 percentage-point promoter sell-down. No filing or note identifies a buyer, agreement or open offer; promoters retain a 73.15% majority.

The President of India, acting through the Ministry of Finance (promoter), sold 6.5% of Life Insurance Corporation of India's capital, cutting the promoter-and-group holding from 96.5% to 90.0%. The Government of India remains promoter and controlling owner; no new controller arrived.

Promoter and group holding fell from 83.11% to 76.62% as of an off-quarter 04-Aug-2026 shareholding filing, consistent with fresh share issuance to meet SEBI's minimum public shareholding norm. No new controller; Saurabh Gadgil and the Gadgil promoter group still control the company.

Bain Capital affiliates BC Asia Investments XXV and XIV subscribed to a ~Rs 4,385 crore preferential issue of shares and warrants at Rs 236, and after a mandatory open offer that drew nil tenders, acquired joint control on April 21, 2026, becoming promoters alongside the Nandakumar family; the board was reconstituted.

Promoter, Chairman and Managing Director Srinivasan Ravi sold 5,25,000 shares (2.01% of capital) in the open market on 23 June 2026, cutting his holding from 40.15% to 38.14%; promoter-group holding fell from 48.7% to 42.41%. He remains promoter and Chairman & Managing Director; no new controller arrived.

Promoter Fosun Pharma Industrial Pte. Ltd. sold 6% of Gland Pharma's capital in the open market in September 2026, cutting its holding to 45.76%; promoter-and-group holding fell from 51.77% to 45.75%. No new promoter or controlling owner arrived.

The President of India (Ministry of Power), NHPC's promoter, sold about 6.01% of the capital in June 2026. Promoter-and-group holding fell from 67.4% to 61.39%. The Government remains promoter with majority control; no new controlling owner arrived.

Promoter-and-group holding (Government of India) stayed 66.14% through 2026-06-30, then fell to 60.14% at 2026-09-30, a 6 percentage-point drop. No filing explains it; Reg 29 shows no promoter sale. Government remains the controlling promoter with a clear majority.

The President of India, acting through the Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance, sold 6% of Bank of Maharashtra's capital, cutting the government promoter holding from 79.6% to 73.6%. The Government of India remains promoter and controlling owner.

Promoter Dr. Neena Tyagi sold 5.85% of the capital in the open market, cutting her holding to 0.62%. Total promoter-and-group holding fell from 61.64% to 55.8%, where it stayed through 2026-09-30. The same promoter group retains majority control.

Promoter Surenderpal Singh Saluja sold 5.33% of the capital in the open market in May 2026. Promoter-and-group holding fell from 63.94% to 58.49%, still a clear majority. No new promoter arrived; the Saluja promoter group continues to control the company.

The Burman family, already classified as promoters after the open offer completed in February 2025, kept raising its holding — converting preferential warrants at Rs.235 (allotments on 2025-12-05 and 2026-06-04) and buying in the open market. Promoter and group holding rose from 25.83% to 31.26%; control unchanged.

Promoter private-equity sponsors True North Fund V LLP and Aether (Mauritius) Ltd sold 5.34% of capital in open-market sales disclosed 2026-03-04, cutting promoter-and-group holding from 12.39% to about 6.97%. Institutions such as FMR LLC and Kotak Mahindra Mutual Fund bought; no new controlling owner emerged.

Promoter Aditya Khemka transferred 13.62% of capital by inter-se transfer on 2026-04-01 to the Aditya Khemka Business Family Trust (13.62%, holding 14.15% after) and to family members Shradha (4%), Advay (1%) and Ananmay Khemka (0.37%). Same family retains control; promoter total fell mainly via QIP dilution and minimum-public-shareholding sales.

Fairfax's FIH Mauritius Investments Ltd subscribed to a ₹2,000 crore preferential issue at ₹350/share and completed a 26% open offer plus secondary purchases from the existing promoters. The board noted FIHM acquired control from November 19, 2026 and reclassified FIHM as promoter, HWIC as promoter group; existing promoters continue.

Two promoter family members, Ranadeep Singh Jauhar and Pradeep Singh Jauhar, each sold 2.49% of capital on 2026-09-25 (4.98% combined). Promoter-group holding fell from 49.84% to 44.81%. No new promoter or controlling owner arrived; the same promoter family retains control.

Promoters (Santosh Kumar Yadav, Anju Devi, Manohar Lal and promoter group) gave prior intimation of intent to sell up to 10,00,000 shares for personal and financial reasons, after a Rs 350 crore QIP. Promoter-group holding fell 70.79% to 65.69%. Santosh Kumar Yadav remains Chairman & Managing Director.

Shriram Finance issued fresh shares by preferential allotment to MUFG Bank, Ltd (Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group), which took 20.02% of the enlarged capital. Promoters sold nothing; their holding fell from 25.38% to 20.3% purely by dilution. Shriram Capital Private Limited and Shriram Ownership Trust remain promoters.

The Government of India, BHEL's promoter, sold 5% of the capital, cutting promoter-and-group holding from 63.17% to 58.17% by the 2026-03-31 quarter. The President of India remains majority promoter; no new controlling owner arrived.

The President of India, acting through the Ministry of Finance, sold 5% of GIC Re's capital, cutting promoter holding from 82.4% to 77.4%. The Government of India remains promoter and majority owner; no new controlling owner arrived.

Jana Holdings Limited, a promoter of Jana Small Finance Bank, signed a Share Purchase Agreement on 18 May 2026 to sell 5,160,903 shares (~4.9% of paid-up capital) to TVS Motor Company Limited for INR 193.31 crore. Promoter-and-group holding fell from 21.85% to 16.94%; no open offer and no new controller disclosed.

Promoter-and-group holding fell from 66.5% to 61.48% between June and July 2026 solely because the company allotted 92,23,402 new shares on a preferential basis to non-promoters, taking capital to 12,21,27,437 shares. The only promoter trade was a 0.38% inter-se transfer between two promoter entities.

Promoter Capillary Technologies International Pte Ltd sold about 4.14% of capital (disclosed 2026-08-17), cutting its holding to 44.78%. Total promoter-and-group holding fell from 52.16% to 47.23% by 2026-09-30. No new promoter or acquirer appears; the same promoter entity retains the largest holding and control.

Promoter and group holding rose from 47.05% to 51.66% over the window, with promoter entity Anamudi Real Estates LLP buying 0.31% in the open market (to 3.36%) and no promoter sales. Promoter-group list changes were only LLP strike-offs, a conversion and a new LLP added. Same Godrej promoters throughout.

Promoter group holding fell from 50.56% to 46.28% after a preferential allotment to a non-promoter (Synergy Industrial, Metals and Power Holdings, 4.77%, 12.74% after). Separately, in the June 2026 quarter promoter GMR Enterprises transferred 7,45,56,604 shares (9.55%) by exempt inter-se transfer to its subsidiary GMR Estate Management, taking it to 24.91%.

Existing promoter-group entities Jamnagar Utilities & Power and Sikka Ports & Terminals acquired shares, including via preferential allotment, lifting promoter-and-group holding from 47.12% to 49.13% and then 50.98%. No new controller arrived; the same promoter group continues to control the company.

No outside buyer. Singhania promoter group entities (YPL Enterprises 6.95%, JK Credit 5.54%, Accurate Finman 1.03%) acquired 13.52% of capital, while two Singhania HUFs were dissolved and the late Shri Pranav Hari Singhania was dropped from the promoter group. Promoter holding rose 49.63% to 52.94%.

Promoter holding rose to 61.43% in December 2025 when the Company allotted shares under the NCLT-sanctioned amalgamation of Viyash Life Sciences and others, then fell to 49.24% after promoters CA Harbor Investments and CA Hull Investments sold 10.83% of capital in the open market. They still hold about 46.75%; no new controller.

On December 31, 2025 founder Haridas T. Kanani gifted 21.90% and Beena Kanani 10% of capital to their respective Kanani family trusts (managing trustee Dr. Harin Kanani) under a SEBI SAST exemption order — an internal promoter-family reorganization for succession. Aggregate promoter holding unchanged; Dr. Harin Kanani leads.

No change in Apollo's own ownership. Promoter-group holding slipped from 52.41% to 49.98% purely because the company issued shares — warrant conversions and preferential issues of equity shares and convertible warrants to non-promoter investors, with promoter-group members Kanishka and Chanakya Reddy Baddam themselves subscribing to warrants. Apollo meanwhile acquired Premier Explosives.

Promoter founders Rajesh Kumar Naidu Yabaji and Ramasubramanian Balasubramaniam sold about 1.55% of capital in open-market sales disclosed 2025-12-18; aggregate promoter-group holding fell from 27.19% to 24.99%. No new promoter or controlling owner arrived; founders remain promoters in control.

Promoter-group entities (Samprada & Nanhamati Singh Family Trust and Jayanti Sinha) sold about 2% of the capital in block deals, taking promoter-and-group holding from 51.2% to 49.7% by 30 June 2026. Mutual funds bought. B.N. Singh continues as Executive Chairman; no new controller.
